title: Compliant roofing
summary: A TPO roofing submittal for Section 07 54 23 that meets every requirement.

input.submittalText:
SUBMITTAL 07 54 23-01 - Northwind Denver Office Roof Replacement
Contractor: Peak Roofing Co. Manufacturer: Carlisle SynTec.

1. Membrane: Sure-Weld TPO, reinforced, white, 60 mil (1.5 mm), meets ASTM D6878. Initial solar reflectance index (SRI) 99 per ASTM E1980. UL 790 Class A.
2. Insulation: SecurShield polyiso, ASTM C1289 Type II Class 1, two layers of 2.6 in. with staggered joints, total R-30.
3. System: fully adhered with Sure-Weld bonding adhesive. FM Approved, uplift rating FM 1-90.
4. Warranty: manufacturer's 20-year Total System No Dollar Limit (NDL) warranty covering membrane, insulation and accessories; installer's 2-year workmanship warranty.
5. Installer: Peak Roofing Co. is a Carlisle Authorized Applicator (certification letter attached).
